label: SCG I.22 coverage and both n.4 cases reject a joined distinct quiddity
description: Composes the analyst-coarsened n.2 coverage with the two-case n.4 theorem, in the dependence sense PER_SE_NECESSARY_2. Non-transcription: a three-way case analysis reusing dependent_conjunction_not_quiddity. It is a conditional route from per se necessity to the rejection of every represented-distinct proposed quiddity of an esse-identified bearer; it does not prove that the bearer's actual q.3 essence equals its esse, which would further need the proposed quiddity to range over that essence. Every source-motivated premise is OPEN, attribution deferred; coverage is the premise the co-fundamental control violates. No root obligation is discharged.
